    skateboard_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2] for p in skateboard_patches]
    mattress_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2] for p in mattress_patches]

    closest_mattress = min(mattress_patches, key=lambda m: distance((skateboard_centers[0][0], skateboard_centers[0][1]), (m.left + m.right) / 2, (m.lower + m.upper) / 2))
    
    return closest_mattress
